semantic_contract: Save a copy to the selected location first, then pick a sharing app. The existing Save destination remains unchanged.
The menu calls share=true and export=true, so writeImage does not set savedTarget or markSaved; sharing is invoked after the file write.
Do not say the copy is already shared or that picking a sharing app changes the current Save destination.

Reviewer should verify the share-app construction app til å dela kopien and the chosen-location wording.
